messages:
alex: ran an nsys profile on the nightly after the batching change — saw a ~2.5x GPU time spike for batch=8 on KV-heavy samples, uploading a trimmed trace to gs://redwood-traces/1804123456.nsys :eyes:
maria: grabbing it. did you run with cuBLASLt heuristics enabled or forced algo selection?
alex: heuristics ON (default). also tried disabling heuristics (local run with env `CUBLASLT_ALGO=0`). behavior differs: heuristics picks a workspace-hungry algo for some MxKxN shapes which triggers a cudaMalloc fallback path & extra host syncs. with heuristics off it chooses algo 1 (small workspace) — slower steady perf, but no spike.
ryan: can you paste the nsys timeline snippet? any memcpy stalls or gaps around launches?
alex: timeline shows repeated host-side gaps (~200-400us) around `cublasLtMatmul` launches, plus frequent small `cudaMalloc`/`cudaFree` calls. also see `cublasGemmEx` fallback entries. cut from timeline:
```:Host: cublasLtMatmul -> cudaMalloc(1.2MB)
Host: cublasLtMatmul -> cublasLtMatmul (algo19)
GPU: kernel_x (2.0ms)
Host: cublas fallback -> cublasGemmEx (sync)
```
maria: interesting. are these requests hitting different matrix shapes due to KV cache length?
alex: yes — the problematic traces are from long-context requests where KV cache growth pushes seq_len to ~8k after prefixing. our batcher occasionally mixes short (~512) and long (~8k) sequences into the same coalesced matmul, producing heterogeneous shapes. cuBLASLt heuristics then chooses a fast algo with large workspace for the bigger shapes; workspace alloc fails or causes fallback for the mixed case which triggers host syncs.
sam: so the cross-batch coalescing + heterogeneous seqs is amplifying workspace pressure. two quick options: bucket-by-seq-len before coalescing, or force a workspace cap so cuBLASLt will pick a smaller-algo earlier.
ryan: noted we also got a perf regression after the "cross-batch coalescing" patch last week — maybe it enabled merging across seq-len bins. pinging @infra-bot for the PR diff.
perf-bot: linked PR #842: "cross-batch coalescing: initial adaptive merge" by @maria
maria: I can repro locally with `--batch-size=8 --enable-coalesce --mixing=true`. also added env `CUBLASLT_MAX_WORKSPACE=256KB` that forces algo selection cap.
alex: quick run results: baseline nightly w/o coalesce: median latency 120ms; with coalesce & heuristics ON: median 180ms and big tail. with `CUBLASLT_MAX_WORKSPACE=256KB` spike mostly gone, median ~135ms. throughput slightly lower for long-only batches but much more stable.
ryan: good signal. let's make runtime heuristics aware of seq_len variance: if <batch>.max_len / <batch>.min_len > 3 then disable cross-batch coalescing or pin algo to workspace-safe choice. also we should log the chosen cuBLASLt algo id + workspace size per call into our metrics.
sam: agree. can we add lightweight sampling for `cublasLtGetAlgorithm` outputs and include them as span tags so we can query in traces? add a per-host histogram of chosen algo ids and workspace bytes.
alex: will PR: add `algo_probe` metric to profiling spans + a canary config flag `batcher.bucket_by_seq_len=true` and `batcher.workspace_cap_bytes=262144`. will also add a debug export of `algo_id` and `workspace_requested` to trace exporter.
maria: also filing infra perf sweep ticket to run 24h nightly after changes to measure end-to-end regression vs canary.
ryan: until then, revert the coalescing default to OFF and keep behind flag. safer rollout.
maria: agree :thumbsup:
alex: uploaded a 60s nsys cut and annotated notes in the trace bucket. ping me if you need access.
ryan: thanks — looks actionable. sam, can you own the bucket-by-len implementation?
sam: on it, will open draft PR and add test vectors (mixed short/long sequences) to catch this in CI.
alex: one more note: when heuristics choose algo that needs large workspace, cuBLASLt sometimes does an internal temp allocation per-stream which isn't visible in our host-side mem accounting and causes OOM at high concurrency — another reason to cap.
perf-bot: scheduled perf sweep job: job/algoprobe-180412-24h queued
infra-bot: opened infra ticket #1276: "repro sweep + revert coalescing default"
ryan: good. let's reconvene after the PRs land and the 24h sweep completes. thanks everyone!"
